prisoners.name: Armando Garnica
prisoners.description: Armando Garnica is a U.S. citizen arrested by federal agents during the October 14, 2025 protest in Chicago’s East Side neighborhood following an immigration-enforcement vehicle pursuit and collision. Agents alleged that he pushed through their perimeter while another person was being arrested. Their incident report records his transport to the FBI building and subsequent release without an assault charge at that time. The Illinois Accountability Commission separately documented same-day release of the three U.S. citizens arrested during the protest.

cases.charges: Agents alleged assault or interference with a federal operation; released without an assault charge in the contemporaneous report
cases.sentence: Detained and transported to the FBI, then released the same day. No conviction or sentence established; exact duration and any subsequent prosecution remain unverified. Sources: https://www.loevy.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/284-25-ESTAR-Incident-Report-10.14.2025.pdf (pages 28, 55-56 and 58); https://ilac.illinois.gov/content/dam/soi/en/web/ilac/documents/final-report/inv-briefs/IAC-East-Side-Investigation-Brief-r.pdf (page 5). Agent allegations are not recorded as proven facts. Birth year 2006 is visible in the original report; month and day are redacted. He is not identified as the separate unnamed Walgreens detainee solely because their ages overlap.
